parameters: Hey, scumbag, I'm talkin' to you!
Have it your way, traitor.\! You keep not talkin' and I'll keep pummellin' ya.
Heh heh.\! Y'know, I'm just doin me job.\! If you starve to death down here, it don't matter much to me.\! Sleep tight, prisoner.
What the...\| You can't come down here!
Barbaric.\! How long have they let you languish in here?!
Do not worry, my boy.\! I know what they did to you.\! We won't let them get away with it.
Edmund Pendergast, financier!\! I hope you've heard the name?
Yeah, you've got some money, they say.\! So what do I matter to a man like you?
Just know that I am a friend, and frankly, you could use one right now.\! You'll know what you need to know in time.\! You two, get him out of those chains.
